s: CDU: initialism of Christlich Demokratische Union Deutschlands (“Christian Democratic Union of Germany”)
a radio with a CD drive
My car has no radio with a CD drive.
C major: C major ("the major chord with a root of C").
Das Stück ist in C-Dur geschrieben.
The piece is written in C major.
C major: C major ("the major key with C as its tonic")
C Major has no key signatures (no ♯ and no ♭).
a member or supporter of Christian Democratic Union of Germany (a German political party)

cd's: accusative dative genitive nominative nonstandard plural proscribed
